lines.3: 「All right, I'll train you myself. Listen closely: keep exhaling for ten minutes, then keep inhaling for ten minutes.」
lines.4: The boys were subjected to an insane running drill under the Director's watch.
lines.5: The girls were playing basketball in the gym.
lines.7: Damn Subaru and Fukahire, skipping out on this.
lines.8: 「If a little thing like this wears you out, you'll never be able to defeat a bear!」
lines.9: 「I don't particularly need to defeat one...」
